title: Unbounded cumulative hypotheses converted to the cyclic witness hypotheses
statement: For a positive invertible coefficient order, the lower unbounded cumulative condition yields the cumulative universal lower-degree condition, and failure at q yields failure of the universal degree-q condition.

proof.text: Unfold the canonical-pullback exchange in the unbounded predicate. For every lower natural degree this gives the corresponding universal predicate; if the degree-q universal predicate held, the same canonical comparison would give the unbounded predicate at q, contradicting failure.
